title: A Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in the url/title/author/coverUrl component of FocusPodcast versionCode 70allows…
description: FocusPodcast versionCode 70 contains a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in its url/title/author/coverUrl component. This flaw allows attackers to supply crafted URLs to scan internal resources. No CVSS score or patch information is available.
